iterations.theme: Molitveni dio: molitve zaštite i posvete, Krunica i Litanije Božjem milosrđu te Gospina krunica (radosna otajstva)

sections.subtitle: Evanđelje koje postavlja ton: tko se ponizuje, bit će uzvišen
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar pozdravlja gledatelje i slušatelje medija Ora et Labora i čita evanđelje dana
sections.content:
Emisija počinje kratkim i jasnim pozdravom. Voditelj **Vladimir Grebenar** obraća se „dragim gledateljima i slušateljima medija Ora et Labora“ uobičajenim pozdravom „Pozdrav u Gospodinu“. Odmah zatim izgovara misao vodilju cijelog dana, evanđeoski redak koji će prožimati i kasnije tumačenje:

> „Koji se uzvisuje, bit će ponižen; a koji se ponizuje, bit će uzvišen.“

Nakon ove uvodne rečenice slijedi dugi i strukturirani molitveni blok. Grebenar ga ne prekida komentarima, nego vodi slušatelje kroz niz molitava. Redom se izmjenjuju molitve zaštite i posvete, Krunica i Litanije Božjem milosrđu te Gospina krunica s radosnim otajstvima. Evanđelje o poniznosti tako postaje okvir u koji se smješta sve što slijedi. Molitveni dio počinje znakom križa: „U ime Oca i Sina i Duha Svetoga. Amen.“
sections.subtitle_en: The Gospel that sets the tone: whoever humbles himself will be exalted
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar greets the viewers and listeners of the Ora et Labora media and reads the gospel of the day
sections.content_en:
The show begins with a short and clear greeting. Host **Vladimir Grebenar** addresses the "dear viewers and listeners of the Ora et Labora media" with the customary greeting "Greetings in the Lord." Immediately thereafter, he speaks the guiding thought of the entire day, a gospel verse that will also permeate the later interpretation:

> "Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted."

After this introductory sentence follows a long and structured prayer block. Grebenar does not interrupt it with comments, but rather leads the listeners through a series of prayers. Prayers of protection and consecration, the Chaplet and Litany of the Divine Mercy, and the Rosary of Our Lady with the joyful mysteries alternate in turn. The Gospel of humility thus becomes the framework into which everything that follows is placed. The prayer part begins with the sign of the cross: "In the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit. Amen."

sections.subtitle: Molitva oslobođenja: vezivanje zlih sila i plašt Marijine ljubavi nad obiteljima
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli molitvu oslobođenja i zaštite obitelji od zlih sila
sections.content:
Prva molitva ima izrazito zaštitni karakter. Vladimir Grebenar u ime Isusovo „uzima vlast“ i vezuje sve zle sile i snage. Molitva ih nabraja po mjestima na kojima djeluju:

- u zraku,
- na zemlji,
- u vodi,
- u podzemlju,
- na onome svijetu,
- u prirodi i u vatri.

Molitva zatim prelazi u slavljenje. Bog se ispovijeda kao **Gospodin nad svim svemirom**, a slava mu se daje u ime njegova stvorenja. Molitelji u Isusovo ime vezuju demonske sile „koje su došle protiv nas i naših obitelji“. Sve se stavlja pod zaštitu **dragocjene Kristove krvi**, prolivene na križu.

Važno mjesto ima i Marijin zagovor. Molitva traži zaštitu i posredovanje „kod Presvetog Srca Isusova za sve naše obitelji“, uz snažnu sliku: „Zaogrni nas ovim plaštem ljubavi, da se prestraši neprijatelj.“ U pomoć se zatim zazivaju **sveti Mihovil i anđeli čuvari**, da brane molitelje i njihove obitelji „u borbi protiv svega zla što obilazi svijetom“.

Vrhunac molitve je zapovijed svim silama zla da „odstupe istog časa“ od molitelja, njihovih domova i njihove zemlje. Molitva završava zahvalom Isusu, „jer si vjeran Bog i osjećaš s nama“.
sections.subtitle_en: Prayer of deliverance: binding evil forces and the mantle of Mary's love over families
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host prays a prayer of deliverance and protection of families from evil forces
sections.content_en:
The first prayer has a distinctly protective character. Vladimir Grebenar in Jesus' name "takes authority" and binds all evil forces and powers. The prayer lists them according to the places in which they act:

- in the air,
- on the earth,
- in the water,
- in the underworld,
- in the other world,
- in nature and in fire.

The prayer then turns into praise. God is confessed as **Lord over all the universe**, and glory is given to him in the name of his creation. In Jesus' name, the pray-ers bind demonic forces "that have come against us and our families." Everything is placed under the protection of the **precious blood of Christ**, shed on the cross.

Mary's intercession also holds an important place. The prayer asks for protection and intercession "at the Sacred Heart of Jesus for all our families," with a powerful image: "Cover us with this mantle of love, so that the enemy may be terrified." **Saint Michael and the guardian angels** are then invoked for help, to defend the pray-ers and their families "in the fight against all evil that roams the world."

The climax of the prayer is a command to all powers of evil to "depart this very hour" from the pray-ers, their homes, and their land. The prayer ends with thanksgiving to Jesus, "because you are a faithful God and you empathize with us."

sections.subtitle: Sveti Mihaele, arkanđele, brani nas u boju
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar izgovara molitvu svetom Mihaelu arkanđelu
sections.content:
Odmah nakon molitve oslobođenja Grebenar izgovara tradicionalnu molitvu **svetom Mihaelu arkanđelu**. Ona nastavlja temu duhovne borbe. Arkanđela se moli da brani vjernike „u boju protiv pakosti i zasjeda đavolskih“ i da im bude zaklon.

U središtu molitve je ponizna molba da Bog zapovjedi neprijatelju. Mihael se oslovljava kao **„vojvoda vojske nebeske“**. Od njega se traži da Sotonu i druge zle duhove, „koji svijetom obilaze na propast duša“, božanskom krepošću i jakošću strovali u pakao.

Kratka i sažeta, ova molitva zaokružuje uvodni, zaštitni dio programa prije nego što se molitva usmjeri prema intimnijem odnosu s Isusom i Marijom.
sections.subtitle_en: Saint Michael the Archangel, defend us in battle
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar recites the prayer to Saint Michael the Archangel
sections.content_en:
Immediately after the prayer of deliverance, Grebenar recites the traditional prayer to **Saint Michael the Archangel**. It continues the theme of spiritual warfare. The Archangel is prayed to defend the faithful "in battle against the wickedness and snares of the devil" and to be their protection.

At the center of the prayer is a humble petition that God command the enemy. Michael is addressed as **"prince of the heavenly host"**. He is asked to thrust into hell, by divine power and strength, Satan and other evil spirits "who roam through the world for the ruin of souls."

Short and concise, this prayer rounds off the introductory, protective part of the program before the prayer is directed toward a more intimate relationship with Jesus and Mary.

sections.subtitle: „Neka naša srca kucaju zajedno“: molitva za jedinstvo s Isusom
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli nježnu molitvu za jedinstvo s Isusom
sections.content:
Nakon molitava borbe ton se mijenja. Slijedi nježna i osobna molitva upućena „ljupkom Isusu“. Ona izražava čežnju za potpunim jedinstvom s njim i nabraja gotovo cijelo ljudsko biće:

- neka **noge** zajedno hode,
- neka **ruke** budu skupljene u jedinstvu,
- neka **srca** kucaju zajedno,
- neka **duše** budu u skladu,
- neka **misli** budu kao jedno,
- neka **uši** zajedno slušaju tišinu,
- neka **pogledi** duboko prodru jedan u drugi,
- neka **usne** zajedno mole.

Cilj tog jedinstva izražen je u završnoj rečenici: zajednička molitva treba pomoći da se „zadobije milosrđe od vječnoga Oca“. Time se ujedno najavljuje središnja tema ovog molitvenog dijela, a to je Božje milosrđe.
sections.subtitle_en: "May our hearts beat together": prayer for unity with Jesus
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host prays a tender prayer for unity with Jesus
sections.content_en:
After the prayers of combat, the tone changes. There follows a tender and personal prayer addressed to "sweet Jesus." It expresses a longing for complete unity with him and enumerates almost the entire human being:

- may our **feet** walk together,
- may our **hands** be joined in unity,
- may our **hearts** beat together,
- may our **souls** be in harmony,
- may our **thoughts** be as one,
- may our **ears** listen to the silence together,
- may our **glances** deeply penetrate one another,
- may our **lips** pray together.

The goal of this unity is expressed in the closing sentence: communal prayer should help to "obtain mercy from the eternal Father." This at the same time announces the central theme of this prayer part, which is the Divine Mercy.

sections.subtitle: Posveta Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu i predanje Presvetom Srcu Isusovu
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar moli posvetu Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu
sections.content:
Sljedeće dvije molitve čine cjelinu predanja. Prva je **posveta Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu**. Molitelj se obraća „Presvetoj Djevici Mariji, majci i kraljici“ i posvećuje joj „čitavo svoje biće, svoje misli, riječi i djela“. Mariji se prepušta da raspolaže sa svime što mu pripada, „sada i u vječnosti“. Svrha je trostruka: hvala i slava Presvetoga Trojstva, posvećenje Crkve i spasenje svega svijeta.

U drugom dijelu posvete molitelj traži pomoć da živi dostojno svoga **krsnog posvećenja** i da „neopozivo pripada svome Otkupitelju“. Moli i da, poput Marije, sluša poticaje Duha Svetoga te da se u njemu i u svemu vrši volja Božja.

Zatim slijedi **molitva Presvetom Srcu Isusovu**, „izvoru svakoga dobra“. Ona počinje klanjanjem, ispoviješću vjere i pouzdanja te kajanjem za grijehe. Molitelj Isusu poklanja svoje „siromašno srce“ i moli da ga učini:

- poniznim,
- strpljivim,
- čistim,
- i u svemu skladnim s Isusovim željama.

Molitva završava nizom konkretnih molbi: da molitelj živi u Isusu i Isus u njemu, da ga štiti u opasnostima i tješi u nevoljama i žalostima, da mu udijeli zdravlje tijela, blagoslovi sav rad i podari **milost svete smrti**. Molba za ponizno srce lijepo se povezuje s uvodnim evanđeljem dana.
sections.subtitle_en: Consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary and surrender to the Sacred Heart of Jesus
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar prays the consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary
sections.content_en:
The following two prayers form a whole of surrender. The first is the **consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary**. The pray-er addresses the "Blessed Virgin Mary, mother and queen" and consecrates to her "one's entire being, one's thoughts, words, and deeds." Mary is left to dispose of everything that belongs to him, "now and in eternity." The purpose is threefold: the praise and glory of the Most Holy Trinity, the sanctification of the Church, and the salvation of the whole world.

In the second part of the consecration, the pray-er asks for help to live worthily of his **baptismal consecration** and to "belong irrevocably to his Redeemer." He also prays that, like Mary, he may listen to the promptings of the Holy Spirit and that the will of God may be done in him and in everything.

Then follows the **prayer to the Sacred Heart of Jesus**, "the source of every good." It begins with adoration, confession of faith and trust, and contrition for sins. The pray-er gives his "poor heart" to Jesus and prays that he make it:

- humble,
- patient,
- pure,
- and in everything in harmony with Jesus' desires.

The prayer ends with a series of concrete petitions: that the pray-er may live in Jesus and Jesus in him, that he protect him in dangers and comfort him in troubles and sorrows, that he grant him health of body, bless all work, and bestow the **grace of a holy death**. The petition for a humble heart ties in nicely with the opening gospel of the day.

sections.subtitle: Krunica Božjega milosrđa: „Po njegovoj pregorkoj muci, budi milosrdan nama i cijelome svijetu“
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj predvodi Krunicu Božjega milosrđa, molitva „Vječni Oče, prikazujemo ti…“
sections.content:
U 00:03:45 Vladimir Grebenar najavljuje **Krunicu Božjega milosrđa**, središnji dio molitvenog programa u epizodi naslovljenoj „Milosrđe Božje“. Krunica počinje trima temeljnim molitvama:

- **Oče naš**,
- **Zdravo Marijo**,
- **Vjerovanje** („Vjerujem u Boga Oca svemogućega…“), u kojem se ispovijeda vjera u Krista začetog po Duhu Svetom, rođenog od Marije Djevice i mučenog pod Poncijem Pilatom, te u svetu Crkvu katoličku, općinstvo svetih, oproštenje grijeha, uskrsnuće tijela i život vječni.

Srž krunice čini prikazanje Ocu, koje se ponavlja na početku svakog desetka:

> „Vječni Oče, prikazujemo ti tijelo i krv, dušu i božanstvo preljubljenoga Sina tvojega, Gospodina našega Isusa Krista, kao zadovoljštinu za grijehe naše i cijeloga svijeta.“

Nakon prikazanja slijedi niz ponovljenih zaziva: **„Po njegovoj pregorkoj muci, budi milosrdan nama i cijelome svijetu.“** Grebenar ih izgovara mirnim, ujednačenim ritmom. Ponavljanje prožima gotovo osam minuta snimke i stvara meditativno ozračje.

Ovakav način molitve naglašava poruku zajedništva. Moli se milosrđe ne samo za pojedinca, nego „nama i cijelome svijetu“. Isusova muka pritom se predstavlja kao temelj na kojem se svaka molba za oproštenje i smilovanje oslanja.
sections.subtitle_en: Chaplet of the Divine Mercy: "For the sake of His sorrowful Passion, have mercy on us and on the whole world"
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host leads the Chaplet of the Divine Mercy, prayer "Eternal Father, we offer you…"
sections.content_en:
At 00:03:45 Vladimir Grebenar announces the **Chaplet of the Divine Mercy**, the central part of the prayer program in the episode titled "The Divine Mercy." The Chaplet begins with three basic prayers:

- **Our Father**,
- **Hail Mary**,
- **Creed** ("I believe in God the Father almighty…"), in which faith is confessed in Christ conceived by the Holy Spirit, born of the Virgin Mary, and suffered under Pontius Pilate, and in the holy Catholic Church, the communion of saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting.

The core of the chaplet consists of the offering to the Father, which is repeated at the beginning of each decade:

> "Eternal Father, we offer you the body and blood, soul and divinity of your dearly beloved Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, in atonement for our sins and those of the whole world."

After the offering follows a series of repeated invocations: **"For the sake of His sorrowful Passion, have mercy on us and on the whole world."** Grebenar recites them in a calm, steady rhythm. The repetition permeates almost eight minutes of the recording and creates a meditative atmosphere.

This manner of praying emphasizes the message of communion. Mercy is prayed for not only for the individual, but "on us and on the whole world." Jesus' passion is presented here as the foundation on which every petition for forgiveness and mercy rests.

sections.subtitle: „Sveti Bože, sveti jaki Bože“ i trostruko „Isuse, uzdam se u tebe“
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar završava krunicu trostrukim „Isuse, uzdam se u tebe“
sections.content:
Završetak Krunice Božjega milosrđa u 00:11:38 donosi drugačiji ritam. Grebenar tri puta izgovara drevni zaziv:

> „Sveti Bože, sveti jaki Bože, sveti besmrtni Bože, smiluj se nama i cijelome svijetu.“

Slijedi zaziv koji Isusovo srce prikazuje kao izvor milosrđa: „O krvi i vodo, što potekoste iz srca Isusova, kao izvor milosrđa za nas, uzdam se u tebe.“ Zatim se zaziva i Marija kao **majka milosrđa**, s molbom da moli za vjernike.

Vrhunac čini trostruko ponovljena kratka molitva pouzdanja: **„Isuse, uzdam se u tebe.“** Ona u sažetom obliku izražava cijelu duhovnost Božjeg milosrđa. Krunica se zaključuje molbom: „Smiluj se nama i cijelomu svijetu, Gospodine.“
sections.subtitle_en: "Holy God, Holy Mighty One" and the threefold "Jesus, I trust in you"
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar finishes the chaplet with the threefold "Jesus, I trust in you"
sections.content_en:
The conclusion of the Chaplet of the Divine Mercy at 00:11:38 brings a different rhythm. Grebenar recites the ancient invocation three times:

> "Holy God, Holy Mighty One, Holy Immortal One, have mercy on us and on the whole world."

There follows an invocation presenting the heart of Jesus as the fountain of mercy: "O blood and water, which gushed forth from the heart of Jesus as a fount of mercy for us, I trust in you." Then Mary is also invoked as **mother of mercy**, with a petition that she pray for the faithful.

The climax is formed by the threefold repeated short prayer of trust: **"Jesus, I trust in you."** In summary form, it expresses the entire spirituality of the Divine Mercy. The Chaplet concludes with the petition: "Have mercy on us and on the whole world, Lord."

sections.subtitle: Litanije Božjem milosrđu: od tajne Trojstva do utjehe umirućih
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli Litanije Božjem milosrđu, zaziv „Milosrđe Božje, ti neshvatljiva tajno Presvetoga Trojstva“
sections.content:
U 00:12:27 slijede **Litanije Božjem milosrđu**. Počinju uobičajenim litanijskim uvodom: „Gospodine, smiluj se. Kriste, smiluj se“, a zatim i zazivima Ocu nebeskom, Sinu Otkupitelju svijeta, Duhu Svetom i Svetom Trojstvu, jednom Bogu.

Svaki sljedeći zaziv počinje riječima „Milosrđe Božje“ i završava odgovorom **„uzdam se u tebe“**. Zazivi zajedno daju gotovo teološki pregled djelovanja Božjeg milosrđa kroz povijest spasenja i ljudski život. Milosrđe se zaziva kao:

- **neshvatljiva tajna Presvetoga Trojstva** i izraz njegove najveće moći,
- milosrđe koje se objavilo u **stvaranju nebeskih duhova** i koje je ljude **iz ništavila pozvalo u život**,
- milosrđe koje obuhvaća čitav svijet i daruje besmrtan život,
- zaštita od zasluženih kazni i oslobođenje od bijede grijeha,
- milosrđe koje se izlijeva **iz rana Kristovih** i izvire iz Presvetoga Srca,
- milosrđe koje je ljudima darovalo **Presvetu Djevicu za majku milosrđa**,
- milosrđe vidljivo u **ustanovljenju Crkve** te u ustanovljenju i dijeljenju sakramenata,
- milosrđe „neograničeno u sakramentu krštenja i pokore“ i „neizmjerno u sakramentu oltara i svećeništva“,
- milosrđe koje poziva k svetoj vjeri, obraća grešnike, posvećuje pravednike i usavršava svete,
- **vrelo bolesnicima i patnicima**, utjeha onih koji su skršena srca i ufanje onih koji očajavaju,
- **mir umirućih**, zaštita od paklenoga ognja i olakšanje patnji dušama u čistilištu,
- slast i neizmjerna radost svih svetih, beskrajno u svim tajnama vjere i neiscrpan izvor čudesa.

Litanije završavaju psalmskim retkom: „Bog je milosrdan i pun samilosti, spor na srđbu i pun dobrote. Zato ću dovijeka klicati milosrđu Božjemu.“
sections.subtitle_en: Litany of the Divine Mercy: from the mystery of the Trinity to the consolation of the dying
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host prays the Litany of the Divine Mercy, invocation "Divine Mercy, you incomprehensible mystery of the Most Holy Trinity"
sections.content_en:
At 00:12:27 follows the **Litany of the Divine Mercy**. It begins with the usual litany introduction: "Lord, have mercy. Christ, have mercy", and then with invocations to the heavenly Father, the Son Redeemer of the world, the Holy Spirit, and the Holy Trinity, one God.

Every subsequent invocation begins with the words "Divine Mercy" and ends with the response **"I trust in you"**. Together, the invocations give almost a theological overview of the action of God's mercy through salvation history and human life. Mercy is invoked as:

- **incomprehensible mystery of the Most Holy Trinity** and expression of its greatest power,
- mercy that was revealed in the **creation of the heavenly spirits** and that called humans **out of nothingness into life**,
- mercy that embraces the entire world and bestows immortal life,
- protection from deserved punishments and liberation from the misery of sin,
- mercy that pours out **from the wounds of Christ** and flows from the Sacred Heart,
- mercy that granted human beings the **Blessed Virgin as mother of mercy**,
- mercy visible in the **institution of the Church** and in the institution and administration of the sacraments,
- mercy "unlimited in the sacrament of baptism and penance" and "immense in the sacrament of the altar and the priesthood",
- mercy that calls to the holy faith, converts sinners, sanctifies the righteous, and perfects the saints,
- **fount for the sick and suffering**, consolation of those who are brokenhearted and hope of those who despair,
- **peace of the dying**, protection from hellfire and relief of sufferings for the souls in purgatory,
- delight and immense joy of all the saints, boundless in all mysteries of faith and an inexhaustible source of miracles.

The litany ends with a psalm verse: "The Lord is gracious and full of compassion, slow to anger and of great mercy. Therefore I will sing of the mercies of the Lord forever."

sections.subtitle: Da u teškim trenucima ne očajavamo: završna molitva pouzdanja
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar izgovara završnu molitvu „Pomolimo se. O vječni Bože…“
sections.content:
Litanije zaključuje svečana molitva koju Grebenar uvodi riječju „Pomolimo se“. Upućena je vječnom Bogu, „čije je milosrđe neistraživo i čije blago smilovanja neiscrpivo“.

U njoj se moli da Bog umnoži svoje milosrđe u vjernicima. Svrha je izrazito pastoralna: **„da u teškim trenucima ne očajavamo i ne budemo obeshrabreni“**. Vjernici se trebaju s velikim pouzdanjem predati Božjoj svetoj volji, „koja je sama ljubav i smilovanje“.

Molitva završava po Isusu Kristu, koji se ovdje naziva **„kraljem milosrđa“** i koji s Ocem i Duhom Svetim „iskazuje milosrđe u sve vijeke vjekova“. Time se zaokružuje cjelina posvećena Božjem milosrđu. Predanje Božjoj volji pritom se nadovezuje na ranije molitve posvete, u kojima se molilo da se „u svemu vrši volja Božja“.
sections.subtitle_en: That in difficult moments we may not despair: closing prayer of trust
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar recites the closing prayer "Let us pray. O eternal God…"
sections.content_en:
The litany is concluded by a solemn prayer that Grebenar introduces with the word "Let us pray." It is addressed to the eternal God, "whose mercy is unfathomable and whose treasure of compassion is inexhaustible."

In it, prayer is made that God multiply his mercy in the faithful. The purpose is distinctly pastoral: **"that in difficult moments we may not despair and not be despondent"**. The faithful should surrender themselves with great trust to God's holy will, "which is love and mercy itself."

The prayer ends through Jesus Christ, who is here called the **"king of mercy"** and who with the Father and the Holy Spirit "shows mercy forever and ever." This rounds off the whole part dedicated to the Divine Mercy. Surrender to God's will thereby connects to earlier prayers of consecration, in which it was prayed that "the will of God be done in everything."

sections.subtitle: Gospina krunica: radosna otajstva od začeća do pohoda Elizabeti
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj najavljuje Gospinu krunicu i prvo otajstvo
sections.content:
Kratkom najavom „Slijedi Gospina krunica“ Vladimir Grebenar u 00:16:50 započinje drugi veliki molitveni ciklus, a to su **radosna otajstva**. Svaki desetak ima istu strukturu:

- najava otajstva,
- **Oče naš**,
- deset puta **Zdravo Marijo**,
- **Slava Ocu**,
- molitva **„O moj Isuse, oprosti nam naše grijehe, očuvaj nas od paklenoga ognja, dovedi u raj sve duše, a osobito one kojima je najpotrebnije tvoje milosrđe.“**

Završna molitva svakog desetka ponovno ističe temu milosrđa, koja povezuje Gospinu krunicu s prethodnom Krunicom Božjega milosrđa.

**Prvo otajstvo**, najavljeno u 00:16:53, glasi: „koga si, Djevice, po Duhu Svetom začela“. Ono razmatra trenutak utjelovljenja i Marijin pristanak Božjem planu.

**Drugo otajstvo** slijedi u 00:20:51: „koga si, Djevice, idući Elizabeti u pohode nosila“. Ono prati Mariju na putu prema rođakinji Elizabeti dok u sebi nosi Isusa. Oba desetka Grebenar moli istim smirenim, ujednačenim ritmom.
sections.subtitle_en: The Rosary of Our Lady: joyful mysteries from the conception to the visitation to Elizabeth
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host announces the Rosary of Our Lady and the first mystery
sections.content_en:
With the short announcement "The Rosary of Our Lady follows," Vladimir Grebenar at 00:16:50 begins the second large prayer cycle, which is the **joyful mysteries**. Each decade has the same structure:

- announcement of the mystery,
- **Our Father**,
- ten times **Hail Mary**,
- **Glory Be**,
- prayer **"O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell, lead all souls to heaven, especially those in most need of your mercy."**

The closing prayer of each decade highlights once again the theme of mercy, which links the Rosary of Our Lady to the preceding Chaplet of the Divine Mercy.

The **first mystery**, announced at 00:16:53, reads: "whom you, O Virgin, conceived by the Holy Spirit." It contemplates the moment of the incarnation and Mary's consent to God's plan.

The **second mystery** follows at 00:20:51: "whom you, O Virgin, bore in visitation to Elizabeth." It follows Mary on the way to her relative Elizabeth while carrying Jesus within herself. Grebenar prays both decades with the same calm, steady rhythm.

sections.subtitle: Rođenje, prikazanje i pronalazak u hramu: dovršetak radosnih otajstava
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar najavljuje četvrto otajstvo: „koga si, Djevice, u hramu prikazala“
sections.content:
Krunica se nastavlja trećim, četvrtim i petim radosnim otajstvom. Sva tri prate Isusovo djetinjstvo:

- **Treće otajstvo** (00:24:53): „koga si, Djevica, rodila“. Razmatra se rođenje Isusovo.
- **Četvrto otajstvo** (00:29:03): „koga si, Djevice, u hramu prikazala“. Razmatra se prikazanje Isusa u hramu.
- **Peto otajstvo** (00:32:56): „koga si, Djevice, u hramu našla“. Razmatra se trenutak kada Marija pronalazi Isusa u hramu.

Prije najave petog otajstva nastupa nešto duža stanka, nakon čega molitva teče dalje istim redoslijedom. Svaki desetak završava doksologijom „Slava Ocu i Sinu i Duhu Svetomu. Kako bijaše na početku, tako i sada i vazda i u vijeke vjekova. Amen“ i molitvom „O moj Isuse“, u kojoj se moli oproštenje grijeha i spasenje duša kojima je Božje milosrđe najpotrebnije.

Radosna otajstva tako prolaze kroz Isusovo djetinjstvo, od Marijina začeća po Duhu Svetom do pronalaska dječaka Isusa u hramu.
sections.subtitle_en: Nativity, presentation, and finding in the temple: completion of the joyful mysteries
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar announces the fourth mystery: "whom you, O Virgin, presented in the temple"
sections.content_en:
The Rosary continues with the third, fourth, and fifth joyful mysteries. All three follow Jesus' childhood:

- **Third mystery** (00:24:53): "whom you, O Virgin, brought forth." The birth of Jesus is contemplated.
- **Fourth mystery** (00:29:03): "whom you, O Virgin, presented in the temple." The presentation of Jesus in the temple is contemplated.
- **Fifth mystery** (00:32:56): "whom you, O Virgin, found in the temple." The moment when Mary finds Jesus in the temple is contemplated.

Before the announcement of the fifth mystery, a slightly longer pause occurs, after which the prayer flows further in the same order. Each decade ends with the doxology "Glory be to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen" and the prayer "O my Jesus," in which forgiveness of sins and the salvation of souls who most need God's mercy are implored.

The joyful mysteries thus move through Jesus' childhood, from Mary's conception by the Holy Spirit to the finding of the boy Jesus in the temple.

sections.subtitle: „Zdravo Kraljice, majko milosrđa“: završni pozdrav Djevici
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj zaključuje molitveni dio molitvom „Zdravo Kraljice“
sections.content:
Molitveni dio završava u 00:37:01 molitvom **„Zdravo Kraljice“**. Marija se u njoj ponovno oslovljava kao **„majka milosrđa“**, čime se vraća glavna tema epizode. Naziva se i „život, slast i ufanje naše“.

Molitva slikovito opisuje ljudsko stanje. Vjernici su „prognani sinovi Jevini“ koji Mariji vapiju i uzdišu „tugujući i plačući u ovoj suznoj dolini“. Mariju, „zagovornicu“, mole da na njih svrne svoje milostive oči te da im „poslije ovoga progona“ pokaže Isusa, „blagoslovljeni plod utrobe svoje“.

Molitva završava nježnim trostrukim zazivom: **„O blaga, o mila, o slatka Djevice Marijo. Amen.“** Time se zatvara više od pola sata neprekinute molitve. Ona je započela vezivanjem zlih sila i zaštitom obitelji, a završava predanjem pod okrilje Marije kao majke milosrđa.
sections.subtitle_en: "Hail, Holy Queen, Mother of Mercy": closing greeting to the Virgin
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host concludes the prayer part with the prayer "Hail, Holy Queen"
sections.content_en:
The prayer part ends at 00:37:01 with the prayer **"Hail, Holy Queen"**. In it, Mary is again addressed as **"Mother of Mercy"**, which brings back the main theme of the episode. She is also called "our life, our sweetness, and our hope."

The prayer vividly describes the human condition. The faithful are "poor banished children of Eve" who cry and sigh to Mary, "mourning and weeping in this valley of tears." They ask Mary, their "advocate," to turn her eyes of mercy toward them and, "after this exile," show unto them Jesus, "the blessed fruit of thy womb."

The prayer ends with a tender threefold invocation: **"O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary. Amen."** This concludes more than half an hour of uninterrupted prayer. It began with the binding of evil forces and the protection of families, and ends with surrender under the mantle of Mary as mother of mercy.

iterations.theme_en: Prayer part: prayers of protection and consecration, Chaplet and Litany of the Divine Mercy, and the Rosary of Our Lady (joyful mysteries)

iterations.theme: Tumačenje Božje riječi: radovati se onome čemu se Isus raduje, poniznost i osobno svjedočanstvo voditelja

sections.subtitle: „Meni je živjeti Krist, a umrijeti dobitak“: Pavlova radost usred okova
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar započinje čitanje iz Poslanice Filipljanima
sections.content:
Nakon zajedničke molitve krunice i pozdrava Zdravo Kraljice, voditelj emisije **Vladimir Grebenar** prelazi na središnji dio susreta, tumačenje svete riječi. Za početak čita odlomak iz **Poslanice Filipljanima**, tekst koji će obilježiti cijelo razmatranje.

U čitanju sveti Pavao piše: „Braćo, samo neka se na svaki način, bilo himbeno, bilo istinito, Krist navješćuje, i tome se radujem, a i radovat ću se.“ Apostol nastavlja da se nada kako se ni zbog čega neće smesti te da će se Krist uzveličati u njegovu tijelu, bilo životom bilo smrću. Iz toga proizlazi i čuvena rečenica: **„Meni je živjeti Krist, a umrijeti dobitak.“**

Grebenar čita i Pavlovu unutarnju dvojbu. Apostol se osjeća pritiješnjenim između dvije mogućnosti. S jedne strane želi otići i biti s Kristom, „jer to je mnogo, mnogo bolje“. S druge strane, ostati u tijelu „potrebnije je poradi vas“, za napredak i radost vjere zajednice kojoj piše. Upravo će prva rečenica tog odlomka, Pavlova radost što se Krist navješćuje, postati ključ cijelog tumačenja.
sections.subtitle_en: "For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain": Paul's joy in the midst of chains
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar begins reading from the Epistle to the Philippians
sections.content_en:
After communal prayer of the rosary and the Hail, Holy Queen greeting, the host of the show, **Vladimir Grebenar**, moves to the central part of the gathering, the interpretation of the holy word. To begin, he reads a passage from the **Epistle to the Philippians**, a text that will mark the entire reflection.

In the reading, Saint Paul writes: "Brethren, only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed, and in that I rejoice, yes, and I will rejoice." The apostle continues that he hopes he will in no way be confounded, and that Christ will be magnified in his body, whether by life or by death. From this comes the famous sentence: **"For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain."**

Grebenar also reads Paul's inner dilemma. The apostle feels hard-pressed between two possibilities. On the one hand, he desires to depart and be with Christ, "for that is far, far better." On the other hand, to remain in the flesh is "more necessary for your sake," for the progress and joy of faith of the community to which he writes. It is precisely the first sentence of that passage, Paul's joy that Christ is proclaimed, that will become the key to the entire interpretation.

sections.subtitle: Tajna Pavlova uspjeha: radovao se tuđem navještaju
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj objašnjava zašto je sveti Pavao bio uspješan u evangelizaciji
sections.content:
Tumačeći pročitano, Vladimir Grebenar najprije pojašnjava izraz „himbeno“. Prema njegovim riječima, riječ je o navještaju koji dolazi „s nekim interesom, ne onako iz srca“. Pavlu je ipak važno samo to da se Isus navješćuje, a tome se raduje i radovat će se.

U tome voditelj vidi **odgovor na pitanje zašto je Pavao bio toliko uspješan u evangelizaciji**: radovao se što drugi navješćuju Krista. Zatim slušatelje poziva da zamisle Isusa, raspetoga Spasitelja, kako se raduje kada ga ljudi navješćuju, pronose njegovo ime po svijetu, ne zataje ga, svjedoče za njega, hvale ga i slave.

### Otac stolar i sin koji ga nadmaši

Kako bi to približio, Grebenar se služi slikom iz svakodnevnog života. Svaki se roditelj raduje kad njegovo dijete uspije u nečemu čemu ga je on poučio. Kao primjer navodi oca poduzetnika, stolara, koji sina nauči zanatu. Takav se otac raduje kad vidi da sin nastavlja isti posao, a još više kad je sin bolji od njega.

Isto vrijedi i za Isusa. Voditelj podsjeća na Isusove riječi: **„Tko u mene bude vjerovao, činit će i djela veća nego što sam ja činio.“** Tumači ih tako da Isus odlazi Ocu, a njegovi učenici ostaju na zemlji i imaju vremena činiti još veća djela. Isus se, zaključuje Grebenar, raduje kad vidi da ljudi u njegovo ime čine velika djela.
sections.subtitle_en: The secret of Paul's success: he rejoiced in another's proclamation
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host explains why Saint Paul was successful in evangelization
sections.content_en:
Interpreting what was read, Vladimir Grebenar first clarifies the expression "in pretense." According to his words, it is a matter of a proclamation that comes "with some self-interest, not like from the heart." For Paul, however, what matters is only that Jesus is proclaimed, and in that he rejoices and will rejoice.

In this the host sees the **answer to the question of why Paul was so successful in evangelization**: he rejoiced that others proclaimed Christ. Then he invites the listeners to imagine Jesus, the crucified Savior, rejoicing when people proclaim him, carry his name throughout the world, do not disown him, bear witness to him, praise him, and glorify him.

### The carpenter father and the son who surpasses him

To make this accessible, Grebenar uses an image from everyday life. Every parent rejoices when his child succeeds in something he taught him. As an example, he mentions an entrepreneur father, a carpenter, who teaches his son the trade. Such a father rejoices when he sees the son continuing the same work, and even more when the son is better than he is.

The same applies to Jesus. The host recalls Jesus' words: **"Whoever believes in me will also do greater works than I have done."** He interprets them to mean that Jesus goes to the Father, and his disciples remain on earth and have time to do even greater works. Jesus, Grebenar concludes, rejoices when he sees people doing great works in his name.

sections.subtitle: Test vjere: radujete li se kad drugi pronose Isusovo ime?
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj postavlja gledateljima pitanje za samoispitivanje vjere
sections.content:
Iz Pavlova stava Vladimir Grebenar izvodi konkretan **„test vjere“** koji svatko može primijeniti na sebe. Pitanje glasi: raduješ li se kad netko drugi pronosi ime Isusovo? Raduješ li se iskreno, u srcu, kad je netko uspješan u evangelizaciji i kad njegov rad donosi plodove? Je li ti drago reći: „Bravo, vidi kako je ovo lijepo“, kad neki muškarac ili žena lijepo svjedoče o Isusu, mole, a ljudi se obraćaju i spašavaju se životi?

„Ako se raduješ, na pravom si putu“, poručuje voditelj. Blaženima naziva sve koji se raduju onome čemu se Bog raduje, a to su, prema njegovim riječima, **obraćenja ljudi**, bez obzira na to gdje se i kako događaju. Posebno ističe da je Pavao rečenicu „tome se radujem i radovat ću se“ zaključio uskličnikom.

### Žalost zbog propadanja kršćanstva

Isti kriterij djeluje i u suprotnom smjeru. Ako se Krist ne navješćuje i kršćanstvo propada, što se, kako Grebenar navodi, „nažalost vidi vlastitim očima u **zapadnoj Europi**“, onda se vjernici trebaju žalostiti, jer je i Isus zbog toga žalostan. Toliki su dali svoj život da bi se kršćanstvo proširilo, a onda je došla jedna generacija i sve to izgubila. „Evo, to se sad događa“, upozorava voditelj.

### Pred križem, s Duhom Svetim

Grebenar naglašava da Božja riječ prodire duboko u srce i daje jasan kriterij za samoprocjenu. Najbolje je, kaže, kad čovjek sam sebe može ocijeniti prema jasnim mjerilima, a da mu nitko ništa ne mora govoriti. Predlaže da vjernik stane pred križ, preispita se i zamoli Duha Svetoga da mu otkrije istinu o njemu samome:

- raduje li se onome čemu se Isus raduje,
- žalosti li se zbog onoga zbog čega je Isus žalostan.
sections.subtitle_en: Test of faith: do you rejoice when others spread Jesus' name?
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host asks the viewers a question for self-examination of faith
sections.content_en:
From Paul's attitude, Vladimir Grebenar derives a concrete **"test of faith"** that anyone can apply to themselves. The question is: do you rejoice when someone else spreads the name of Jesus? Do you rejoice sincerely, in your heart, when someone is successful in evangelization and when their work bears fruit? Are you glad to say: "Well done, look how beautiful this is," when a man or woman bears beautiful witness to Jesus, prays, and people convert and lives are saved?

"If you rejoice, you are on the right track," the host says. He calls blessed all who rejoice in what God rejoices in, which, according to his words, are the **conversions of people**, regardless of where and how they happen. He especially emphasizes that Paul concluded the sentence "in that I rejoice and will rejoice" with an exclamation mark.

### Sorrow over the decline of Christianity

The same criterion works in the opposite direction as well. If Christ is not proclaimed and Christianity is declining, which, as Grebenar states, "is unfortunately seen with one's own eyes in **Western Europe**," then believers should grieve, because Jesus is also sorrowful about it. So many gave their lives so that Christianity would spread, and then a generation came and lost it all. "Look, that is happening right now," the host warns.

### Before the cross, with the Holy Spirit

Grebenar emphasizes that the word of God penetrates deep into the heart and provides a clear criterion for self-assessment. It is best, he says, when a person can evaluate himself according to clear standards without anyone having to tell him anything. He suggests that a believer stand before the cross, examine himself, and ask the Holy Spirit to reveal to him the truth about himself:

- whether he rejoices in what Jesus rejoices in,
- whether he is sorrowful over what makes Jesus sorrowful.

sections.subtitle: „Kao što košuta žudi za izvor-vodom“: čežnja utisnuta u ljudsko srce
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj razmatra psalam o čežnji duše za Bogom
sections.content:
Drugi biblijski tekst dana je psalam koji Vladimir Grebenar čita polako i s naglaskom: „Kao što košuta žudi za izvor-vodom, tako duša moja čezne, Bože, za tobom. Žedna mi je duša Boga, Boga živoga. O, kada ću doći lice Božje gledati?“

Voditelj se posebno zadržava na stihu „duša moja gine kada se spomenem kako koračah u mnoštvu predvodeći ga k domu Božjem“ i ponavlja ga. U njemu vidi sliku duše koja se cijela predaje Bogu i koja je žedna Boga živoga.

Grebenar to naziva „predivnim“ i tumači da je **čežnja za Bogom utisnuta u svakog čovjeka**, jer je čovjek otisak Božje slave i stvoren je na sliku Božju. Zato se, zaključuje, čovjek ne može smiriti dok se ne smiri u Bogu.
sections.subtitle_en: "As the deer pants for streams of water": longing imprinted on the human heart
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host reflects on the psalm about the soul's longing for God
sections.content_en:
The second biblical text of the day is a psalm that Vladimir Grebenar reads slowly and with emphasis: "As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs for you, O God. My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. O, when shall I come and behold the face of God?"

The host lingers especially on the verse "these things I remember, as I pour out my soul: how I would go with the throng and lead them in procession to the house of God" and repeats it. In it he sees an image of a soul that surrenders itself entirely to God and thirsts for the living God.

Grebenar calls this "wonderful" and explains that **longing for God is imprinted on every human being**, because human being is an imprint of God's glory and was created in the image of God. That is why, he concludes, man cannot find rest until he finds rest in God.

sections.subtitle: Prispodoba o prvim mjestima i Pavlova poniznost
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj povezuje poslanicu svetog Pavla s evanđeljem o svadbi
sections.content:
Evanđelje dana donosi prizor u kojem Isus jedne subote dolazi na objed u kuću nekog farizejskog prvaka. Promatrajući kako uzvanici biraju prva mjesta, kaže im prispodobu. Tko je pozvan na svadbu, neka ne sjeda na prvo mjesto, jer može doći časniji uzvanik, pa će domaćin reći: „Ustupi mjesto ovome“, i on će postiđen morati sjesti na posljednje mjesto. Neka radije odmah sjedne na posljednje, kako bi mu domaćin rekao: „Prijatelju, pomakni se naviše“, što će mu biti na čast pred svim sustolnicima. Ulomak završava riječima: **„Jer svaki koji se uzvisuje bit će ponižen, a koji se ponizuje bit će uzvišen.“**

Vladimir Grebenar ističe da je to tekst nad kojim treba mnogo razmatrati i meditirati. Zatim postavlja pitanje: koja je veza između prvog čitanja i evanđelja?

Odgovor nalazi u prvoj rečenici poslanice. Pavao se raduje što Krista navješćuju **drugi**, a ne zato što to sam čini. To, prema voditelju, pokazuje da je apostol bio **jako ponizan čovjek**. Ponizan čovjek gleda što je Božji interes i Božja volja. Grebenar poniznost definira kao vršenje volje Božje i poslušnost Božjim zahtjevima, a Pavao je upravo tako činio ono što mu je Bog govorio u molitvi.
sections.subtitle_en: The parable of the places of honor and Paul's humility
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host connects Saint Paul's epistle with the gospel about the wedding feast
sections.content_en:
The gospel of the day brings a scene in which Jesus, on a Sabbath, goes to dine at the house of a prominent Pharisee. Observing how the guests choose the places of honor, he tells them a parable. When someone is invited to a wedding banquet, let him not take the place of honor, for a more distinguished guest may arrive, and the host will say: "Give this person your seat," and in shame he will have to take the lowest place. Rather, let him immediately go and sit in the lowest place, so that his host may say to him: "Friend, move up higher," which will be an honor for him in the presence of all his fellow guests. The passage ends with the words: **"For all those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted."**

Vladimir Grebenar emphasizes that this is a text over which one needs to reflect and meditate a great deal. Then he asks the question: what is the connection between the first reading and the gospel?

He finds the answer in the first sentence of the epistle. Paul rejoices that Christ is proclaimed by **others**, and not because he does it himself. That, according to the host, shows that the apostle was **a very humble man**. A humble man looks at what is God's interest and God's will. Grebenar defines humility as doing the will of God and obedience to God's demands, and Paul did precisely that—doing what God spoke to him in prayer.

sections.subtitle: Put u Makedoniju: vjera bez putnog osiguranja
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj opisuje opasnosti Pavlova putovanja u Makedoniju
sections.content:
Kao primjer Pavlove poslušnosti Vladimir Grebenar navodi njegov odlazak u **Makedoniju**. Kad je Bog apostolu u snu dao da ide onamo, on je otišao bez žaljenja i bez razmišljanja, iako je, kako sam piše, znao da ga čekaju nevolje. Voditelj citira Pavlove riječi: „Sve mogu u onome koji me jača“ i „Kad sam slab, onda sam jak.“

Grebenar slikovito opisuje uvjete tog putovanja. Pavao nije kupio avionsku kartu, nego je polako prelazio tisuće kilometara preko mnogih kraljevstava, polja i putova punih divljih zvijeri. Voditelj otvoreno kaže da to ne piše u Svetom pismu, ali smatra da je apostol zasigurno bio u opasnosti da ga neka zvijer rastrgne, jer se tada nije putovalo kao danas, kada čovjek sjedne u automobil ili zrakoplov.

### Ostaviti sve i krenuti u neizvjesno

„Pokrenuti se i na riječ Božju otići na drugi kraj svijeta, to je vjera“, poručuje Grebenar. Uspoređuje to s današnjim putovanjima, na koja ljudi ne kreću bez putnog osiguranja koje im refundira troškove liječnika ako se tko razboli. Pavao nije imao ni posao ni socijalnu naknadu, a opasnost ga je vrebala na svakom koraku. Voditelj podsjeća da je apostol u jednom tekstu nabrojio koliko je puta bio kamenovan, bičevan i koliko je brodoloma preživio.

Za Pavla je, zaključuje Grebenar, bilo važno samo jedno: vodi li ga riječ Božja. Ako ga vodi, znao je da mu se ništa neće dogoditi. „To je bila vjera i to jest vjera.“
sections.subtitle_en: Journey to Macedonia: faith without travel insurance
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host describes the dangers of Paul's journey to Macedonia
sections.content_en:
As an example of Paul's obedience, Vladimir Grebenar cites his departure for **Macedonia**. When God gave the apostle in a dream to go there, he went without regret and without second thoughts, even though, as he himself writes, he knew that hardships awaited him. The host quotes Paul's words: "I can do all things through him who strengthens me" and "When I am weak, then I am strong."

Grebenar vividly describes the conditions of that journey. Paul did not buy a plane ticket, but slowly crossed thousands of kilometers across many kingdoms, fields, and paths full of wild beasts. The host openly says that this is not written in Holy Scripture, but believes that the apostle was certainly in danger of being torn apart by some beast, because back then people did not travel as they do today, when a person sits in a car or an airplane.

### Leaving everything and heading into the unknown

"To get moving and go to the other side of the world at the word of God, that is faith," Grebenar conveys. He compares this with today's travels, on which people do not set out without travel insurance that reimburses doctor expenses if someone falls ill. Paul had neither a job nor social assistance, and danger lurked for him at every step. The host recalls that the apostle in one text listed how many times he had been stoned, beaten, and how many shipwrecks he had survived.

For Paul, Grebenar concludes, only one thing mattered: whether the word of God was guiding him. If it was guiding him, he knew that nothing would happen to him. "That was faith, and that is faith."

sections.subtitle: Sjesti na posljednje mjesto: Bog izabire one koji to ne žele
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj govori o tome da Bog za velika djela izabire one koji ih ne žele
sections.content:
Vraćajući se evanđelju, Vladimir Grebenar tumači da će oni koji sebe vide na nekoj poziciji biti poniženi. Ljudi koji sjedaju na prva mjesta, kaže, **ne vide što je Božji interes** i ne raduju se onome čemu se Bog raduje. Da bi se netko mogao radovati onome čemu se Bog raduje, mora sjesti na posljednje mjesto.

Želja srca, prema voditelju, mora biti da se čovjek ponizi i pred Bogom i pred ljudima te da ne želi biti „nešto veliko u životu“. Razlog je jednostavan: **„Bog izabire za velika djela one koji to ne žele.“**

### Kad poziv dođe tamo gdje ga ne želiš

Grebenar objašnjava da Bog često pozove čovjeka upravo na djelo koje taj čovjek ne želi, jer mu je potrebna njegova ili njezina poniznost. Čovjek pristaje samo zato što to Bog traži. Najčešće ni ne zna kako će to izvesti, pa se mora osloniti na milost i pitati: „Kako će to biti? Ja ne znam kako će to biti.“ Tada ga, kaže voditelj, vodi milost Božja, Bog izvanredno upotrijebi njegove talente i sve se poklopi.

Isus time poučava da **pozicija i hijerarhija pripadaju onima koji ih ne žele**. Grebenar to sažima kao poziv da čovjek traži najnižu razinu privilegija i ondje sjedi, pa će ga Bog podići ako to bude htio.
sections.subtitle_en: Sitting in the lowest place: God chooses those who do not want it
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host speaks about how God chooses those who do not want them for great works
sections.content_en:
Returning to the gospel, Vladimir Grebenar interprets that those who see themselves in some position will be humbled. People who sit in the places of honor, he says, **do not see what God's interest is** and do not rejoice in what God rejoices in. In order for someone to be able to rejoice in what God rejoices in, he must sit in the lowest place.

The desire of the heart, according to the host, must be for a person to humble himself both before God and before people, and not to want to be "something big in life." The reason is simple: **"God chooses for great works those who do not want them."**

### When the call comes where you do not want it

Grebenar explains that God often calls a person precisely to a work that that person does not want, because he needs his or her humility. A person consents solely because God asks it. Most often he does not even know how he will carry it out, so he must rely on grace and ask: "How will this be? I do not know how this will be." Then, the host says, God's grace leads him, God extraordinarily employs his talents, and everything falls into place.

Jesus thereby teaches that **position and hierarchy belong to those who do not want them**. Grebenar summarizes this as a call for a person to seek the lowest level of privileges and sit there, and then God will raise him up if he wants to.

sections.subtitle: Osobno svjedočanstvo: „Mislio sam da je to moj kraj“
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar svjedoči o strahu kada je pozvan pokrenuti podcast
sections.content:
Ovu pouku Vladimir Grebenar potkrepljuje vlastitim iskustvom. Kada molitvenu inicijativu i zajednicu Ora et Labora naziva najvećom molitvenom zajednicom na svijetu, kaže da to ne govori zbog sebe, jer to nije njegovo djelo, nego **Gospodinovo**.

Kad ga je Gospodin pozvao da preko interneta pokrene molitvu i tumačenje Božje riječi, priznaje da je pomislio kako je to njegov kraj. Imao je dobar posao i visoko obrazovanje, a bojao se da će si uništiti posao i sve ostalo.

### Strah za poslovni ugled

Grebenar opisuje prirodu svoga posla. Direktori i vlasnici poduzeća zovu ga da rješava teške probleme u poslovnim organizacijama i uvodi nove modele organizacije, što zahtijeva veliko međusobno povjerenje. U tvrtkama sa 100, 200 ili 300 zaposlenih predaje menadžerima, kojih je ponekad 30, a ponekad i 50. Znao je da će oni čim se pojavi upisati njegovo ime i prezime u internetsku tražilicu. Bojao se da će, vide li da snima vjerske podcaste koje prati 50 ljudi, nekolicina reći direktoru: „Koga si ovo doveo? Ovo je neki vjerski fanatik.“

To naziva svojom palom ljudskom naravi. Dodaje da mu je i neprijatelj šaputao: „Odustani, ne idi u to, uništit ćeš se.“ Slično su govorili i neki ljudi koji ga poznaju, „pod navodnicima dobronamjerni“, upozoravajući ga da će uništiti i sebe i obitelj.

### „Ne želim, ali ako je tvoja volja…“

Unatoč svemu, Grebenar je u srcu čuo poziv. Priznaje da je osjećao **ogroman otpor** prema molitvi preko interneta. Poziv je uključivao i preseljenje u **Međugorje**. Bogu je odgovorio: „Ja to ništa ne želim, ali ako je to tvoja volja, ja ću to učiniti.“

Danas ističe plodove i broj ljudi koji su se obratili, „ne zbog mene, nego samo zato što sam poslušao“. Bogu je, poručuje, dovoljno da čovjek posluša.

Rizik je bio stvaran. Kao poduzetnik ima, kako kaže, vrlo riskantan posao. Poduzetnici se međusobno raspituju o suradnicima, pa su dovoljna dva ili tri neuspjela projekta da čovjek dobije etiketu nakon koje ga nitko više ne zove. Uz to su obitelj i djeca. Snimati još i vjerski podcast za njegov je razum bilo „totalno udaranje glavom u zid“.
sections.subtitle_en: Personal testimony: "I thought it was the end of me"
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar testifies about fear when he was called to start a podcast
sections.content_en:
Vladimir Grebenar corroborates this lesson with his own experience. When he calls the prayer initiative and community Ora et Labora the largest prayer community in the world, he says he does not say this because of himself, because it is not his work, but **the Lord's**.

When the Lord called him to launch prayer and the interpretation of the word of God over the internet, he admits he thought that was the end of him. He had a good job and a higher education, and he was afraid he would ruin his business and everything else.

### Fear for business reputation

Grebenar describes the nature of his work. Company directors and owners call him to solve difficult problems in business organizations and introduce new organizational models, which requires great mutual trust. In companies with 100, 200, or 300 employees, he lectures to managers, of whom there are sometimes 30, and sometimes 50. He knew that as soon as he appeared, they would type his first and last name into an internet search engine. He was afraid that, if they saw he recorded religious podcasts followed by 50 people, a few would tell the director: "Who did you bring in here? This is some religious fanatic."

He calls this his fallen human nature. He adds that the enemy also whispered to him: "Give up, don't go into that, you will destroy yourself." Some people who know him, "well-meaning in quotation marks," spoke similarly, warning him that he would destroy both himself and his family.

### "I don't want to, but if it is your will…"

Despite everything, Grebenar heard a call in his heart. He admits he felt **enormous resistance** toward prayer over the internet. The call also included moving to **Međugorje**. He answered God: "I don't want any of this, but if it is your will, I will do it."

Today he highlights the fruits and the number of people who converted, "not because of me, but only because I obeyed." For God, he conveys, it is enough for a person to obey.

The risk was real. As an entrepreneur, he has, as he says, a very risky job. Entrepreneurs ask each other about associates, so two or three failed projects are enough for a person to get a label after which no one calls him anymore. Along with that are family and children. To record a religious podcast on top of that was, for his reason, "totally banging one's head against a wall."

sections.subtitle: Srce ispred razuma i plodovi koje ljudi vide u svojim životima
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj opisuje kako ljudi na skupu u Prozoru dižu ruke svjedočeći o promjeni života
sections.content:
Iz svog iskustva Vladimir Grebenar izvodi duhovno načelo: Bog upravo tako postupa s čovjekom. Dopušta mu da u duhovnom smislu „racijom opali glavom o duhovni zid“, kako bi shvatio da razum pred Bogom ne vrijedi ništa. **Srce je puno važnije.**

To, međutim, ne znači odbacivanje razuma. Kada je srce na Božjoj strani, objašnjava voditelj, Bog oblikuje i razum. Čovjek tada razumije puno dublje i šire i otvaraju mu se nove dimenzije, jer riječ Gospodnju prima srcem.

### Svjedočanstva s terena

U tome Grebenar vidi i razlog zašto ga toliki ljudi slušaju na skupovima. Opisuje kako na susretima, poput onoga koji ga čeka toga dana u **Prozoru**, pita prisutne koliko ih prati emisiju. Ruku podigne otprilike dvije trećine. Na pitanje koliko ih je raslo u vjeri i kome se promijenio život, ponovno se dižu ruke.

Čovjeka se u tome ne može prevariti, naglašava voditelj. Svatko zna je li mu se život promijenio i je li mu nešto bilo na izgradnju ili na štetu. Nitko izvana ne može uvjeriti čovjeka da mu se život nije promijenio, a za tako bitne stvari ljudima, kaže, ne trebaju ni odvjetnici ni tumači.
sections.subtitle_en: Heart before reason and the fruits that people see in their lives
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host describes how people at the gathering in Prozor raise their hands testifying to a life change
sections.content_en:
From his experience, Vladimir Grebenar derives a spiritual principle: God treats man in precisely that way. He allows him in a spiritual sense to "smash his head against a spiritual wall with reason," in order to realize that reason is worth nothing before God. **The heart is much more important.**

This, however, does not mean discarding reason. When the heart is on God's side, the host explains, God also shapes reason. A person then understands much more deeply and broadly, and new dimensions open up to him, because he receives the word of the Lord with his heart.

### Testimonies from the field

In this, Grebenar also sees the reason why so many people listen to him at gatherings. He describes how at meetings, like the one awaiting him that day in **Prozor**, he asks attendees how many of them follow the broadcast. Approximately two-thirds raise their hands. At the question of how many grew in faith and whose life was changed, hands are raised again.

A person cannot be deceived in this, the host emphasizes. Everyone knows whether their life changed and whether something was for their edification or detriment. No one from outside can convince a person that their life did not change, and for such essential things people, he says, need neither lawyers nor interpreters.

sections.subtitle: Zamka priznanja: „Nikad nisam htio voditi molitvenu zajednicu“
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj govori o tome kako nikada nije težio vodstvu ni priznanju
sections.content:
Vladimir Grebenar zatim formulira jedno od ključnih načela tumačenja: tko želi biti uspješan u evangelizaciji, ali i u životu, mora **odbaciti želju da bude netko i nešto i da ga ljudi priznaju**. „To je opasno. To je zamka“, upozorava.

Potom ponovno govori o sebi. Godinama, kaže, nije imao takvih želja i nikada nije htio voditi molitvenu zajednicu. Dok je sudjelovao u **duhovnim vježbama svetog Ignacija**, nije ga zanimalo nikakvo vodstvo. Pratio je samo svoju djecu, kojih je, kako kaže, bilo dosta, i to mu je bilo puno. Važno mu je bilo dovesti djecu da čuju Božju riječ. Koliko je u tome uspio, „vrijeme će pokazati“, iako vjeruje da je uz Božju milost u mnogočemu uspio.

Nikada nije želio biti voditelj molitvene zajednice ili inicijative, a ni direktor u poduzeću ili netko u hijerarhiji. Takav stav naziva važnim preduvjetom da Bog čovjeka može izabrati za neko djelo i zahvalan je Bogu na njemu. Svoje svjedočanstvo zaključuje ponavljanjem misli da **hijerarhija pripada onima koji je ne traže**, a vrše volju Božju i raduju se onome čemu se Bog raduje.
sections.subtitle_en: The trap of recognition: "I never wanted to lead a prayer community"
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host speaks about how he never strived for leadership or recognition
sections.content_en:
Vladimir Grebenar then formulates one of the key principles of the interpretation: whoever wants to be successful in evangelization, but also in life, must **reject the desire to be somebody and something and to be recognized by people**. "That is dangerous. That is a trap," he warns.

Then he speaks about himself again. For years, he says, he had no such desires and never wanted to lead a prayer community. While participating in the **Spiritual Exercises of Saint Ignatius**, he was not interested in any leadership. He was only following his children, of whom, as he says, there were quite a few, and that was plenty for him. What mattered to him was bringing the children to hear the word of God. How much he succeeded in that, "time will tell," although he believes that with God's grace he succeeded in many things.

He never wanted to be a leader of a prayer community or initiative, nor a director in an enterprise, or someone in the hierarchy. He calls such an attitude an important prerequisite for God to be able to choose a person for a work, and he is grateful to God for it. He concludes his testimony by repeating the thought that **hierarchy belongs to those who do not seek it**, but do the will of God and rejoice in what God rejoices in.

sections.subtitle: Tko strpljivo čeka s Gospodinom, dočeka svoju priliku
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj izriče pravilo o strpljivom čekanju s Gospodinom
sections.content:
Vladimir Grebenar upozorava i na drugu stranu evanđeoske pouke. One koji teže vlastitoj slavi i guraju se ondje gdje im nije mjesto **Bog će poniziti**, srušit će ih s tog trona „i bit će to bolno“. Zato Isus savjetuje da se traže zadnja mjesta. Tada će onaj koji dijeli pozicije, a to je Bog, čovjeka staviti na pravo mjesto i reći mu: „Prijatelju, pomakni se naviše.“

Voditelj dodaje i vlastito zapažanje. Kad vidi ljude kojima je važno biti netko u organizaciji i koji se guraju, smatra to znakom da to mjesto nije za njih. Isto vrijedi za one koji ne mogu neko vrijeme istrpjeti razinu nižu od svojih sposobnosti.

### Čišćenje na nižoj razini odgovornosti

Bog, objašnjava Grebenar, može nekoga godinu, dvije, tri ili pet godina držati na razini odgovornosti nižoj od njegovih sposobnosti. Razlog je to što takav čovjek možda jest intelektualno spreman, ali **duhovno nije**. Ako ga Bog priprema za veliko djelo, može ga staviti na nižu razinu kako bi ga očistio i pripremio, a onda ga u pravom trenutku podići puno više nego što je ikad mislio.

Odatle proizlazi pravilo koje voditelj, kako kaže, poznaje iz iskustva: **tko strpljivo čeka s Gospodinom, dočeka svoju priliku.** Bog je savršeno pravedan i svatko će dobiti svoju priliku. Nije moguće, tvrdi Grebenar, da Bog poniznog i poslušnog čovjeka koji vrši njegovu volju ne postavi u pravi trenutak na pravo mjesto, a taj trenutak određuje Bog. Zato nema žurbe. Jedina dopuštena žurba je biti brz i spreman činiti ono što čovjeku dolazi u molitvi.

Ljudske mudrolije i planovi, prema voditelju, ne vrijede ništa. Podsjeća na psalam: **„Ako Jahve kuću ne gradi, uzalud se trude graditelji.“** Tko gradi neko djelo, neka ga gradi s Gospodinom, prihvati mjesto na kojem se sada nalazi i strpljivo čeka govoreći: „Bože, evo me, ako treba i do kraja života ovdje biti.“
sections.subtitle_en: Whoever waits patiently with the Lord will meet his opportunity
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host utters the rule about waiting patiently with the Lord
sections.content_en:
Vladimir Grebenar also warns of the other side of the gospel lesson. Those who strive for their own glory and push themselves where they do not belong **God will humble**, he will cast them down from that throne "and it will be painful." That is why Jesus advises seeking the lowest places. Then the one who distributes positions, who is God, will place the person in the right place and say to him: "Friend, move up higher."

The host also adds his own observation. When he sees people for whom it is important to be someone in an organization and who push themselves, he considers that a sign that the place is not for them. The same applies to those who cannot endure for some time a level lower than their abilities.

### Cleansing at a lower level of responsibility

God, Grebenar explains, can keep someone for a year, two, three, or five years at a level of responsibility lower than his abilities. The reason is that such a person may be intellectually ready, but **spiritually he is not**. If God is preparing him for a great work, he can place him at a lower level to cleanse and prepare him, and then at the right moment raise him up much higher than he ever thought.

From this arises the rule that the host, as he says, knows from experience: **whoever waits patiently with the Lord will meet his opportunity.** God is perfectly just and everyone will get their opportunity. It is not possible, Grebenar claims, that God would not place a humble and obedient person who does his will in the right place at the right moment, and that moment is determined by God. Therefore, there is no rush. The only permitted hurry is to be prompt and ready to do what comes to a person in prayer.

Human cleverness and plans, according to the host, are worth nothing. He recalls the psalm: **"Unless the Lord builds the house, those who build it labor in vain."** Whoever builds a work, let him build it with the Lord, accept the place where he currently is, and wait patiently, saying: "God, here I am, even if I have to stay here until the end of my life."
keywords_en: Unless the Lord builds the house

sections.subtitle: Rezultati kao štit: od sporta do evangelizacije
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj uspoređuje važnost rezultata kod nogometnog trenera i u evangelizaciji
sections.content:
Zatvarajući krug, Vladimir Grebenar se vraća svetom Pavlu. Apostol se radovao što drugi navješćuju Krista i zato ga je, prema voditeljevu tumačenju, Bog podigao da je mogao „cijelu Europu pokrstiti“. Pavao je znao koja je temeljna vrijednost njegova života: Isus, koji je za njega dobitak, „kako je lijepo napisao“.

Na tom tragu Grebenar poziva slušatelje da preispitaju svoj život. Vjernici bi se, kaže, trebali baviti pitanjem **što oni sami čine za Isusa**, a ne što čine drugi. Kad čuju za tuđi trud, neka se raduju, a zatim neka se zapitaju: „Vidi drugoga kako čini. A što ja činim? Gdje su moji rezultati?“

### „Rezultat je najbolji prijatelj“

Voditelj za sebe kaže da je čovjek koji traži rezultate. Rezultat je, prema njegovim riječima, često najbolji, a ponekad i jedini prijatelj. Kad krenu napadi, „bujice“ i protivljenje, rezultati štite i brane, jer protiv njih nitko ne može. To vrijedi u poslu i u sportu. Navijači i uprava kluba mogu ne voljeti nekog trenera, ali ako on ima rezultate, nitko ga ne dira. Isto je u politici i u drugim područjima.

Tako je, zaključuje Grebenar, i u evangelizaciji. Tko ima rezultate, toga štiti milost Božja, jer surađuje s njom. Tumačenje završava pozivom da se vjernici ponize, „pa da nas Bog uzvisi kako on želi“.
sections.subtitle_en: Results as a shield: from sports to evangelization
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host compares the importance of results for a football coach and in evangelization
sections.content_en:
Closing the circle, Vladimir Grebenar returns to Saint Paul. The apostle rejoiced that others proclaimed Christ, and that is why, according to the host's interpretation, God raised him up so that he was able to "baptize the whole of Europe." Paul knew the fundamental value of his life: Jesus, who for him was gain, "as he beautifully wrote."

Along those lines, Grebenar invites the listeners to examine their own lives. Believers, he says, should occupy themselves with the question of **what they themselves are doing for Jesus**, and not what others are doing. When they hear of another's effort, let them rejoice, and then let them ask themselves: "Look at the other person doing it. But what am I doing? Where are my results?"

### "Result is the best friend"

The host says of himself that he is a man who seeks results. The result, according to his words, is often the best, and sometimes the only friend. When attacks, "torrents," and opposition begin, results protect and defend, because no one can go against them. This applies in business and in sports. Fans and club management may dislike a coach, but if he has results, no one touches him. It is the same in politics and in other fields.

So it is, Grebenar concludes, in evangelization as well. Whoever has results is protected by God's grace, because he cooperates with it. The interpretation ends with an invitation for believers to humble themselves, "so that God may exalt us as he wills."

sections.subtitle: Od Rame do Imotskog: najave skupova i poziv na podršku centru Kraljica Mira
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj najavljuje promociju knjige u Prozoru i skupove u Dalmaciji
sections.content:
Na kraju emisije Vladimir Grebenar donosi najave za naredne dane. Toga dana, u **subotu 31. listopada**, održava se promocija knjige u **Prozoru (Rama)**, u dvorani hidroelektrane Rama. Slušatelje sa sjevera Hercegovine moli da baner s Facebook stranice Ora et Labora podijele na svojim društvenim mrežama i pozovu nekoga kome bi moglo koristiti da čuje svjedočanstvo i riječ Gospodnju.

Raspored skupova za sljedeći tjedan, uvijek s početkom u 19 sati:

- **ponedjeljak, 2. studenoga**: Biograd na Moru, hotel Ilirija,
- **utorak, 3. studenoga**: Solin, hotel President Solin,
- **srijeda, 4. studenoga**: Imotski, Pučko otvoreno učilište Imotski.

Voditelj savjetuje da posjetitelji dođu ranije kako bi pronašli mjesto. Tjedan nakon toga putuje u Slavoniju, a gradove u kojima će gostovati najavit će naknadno.

Grebenar sve poziva da postanu članovi **domoljubne inicijative Ora et Labora** preko web-stranice diol.hr ili putem objavljenih brojeva mobitela. Prenosi i molbu Hrvata izvan domovine da se pozovu sunarodnjaci iz iseljeništva na **molitvu krunice na glavnom trgu u Zagrebu**, a poziv na molitvu krunice upućuje i svim drugim gradovima.

Emisija završava blagoslovom u ime svete Majke, njezina Sina i svetog Josipa. Uz to voditelj napominje da se kupnjom prve, druge i treće knjige *Isus Lider* pomaže dovršetak **međunarodnog edukacijskog centra Kraljica Mira u Međugorju**. Posljednje su riječi poziv da se Ora et Labora prati svaki dan, „na veću slavu Božju“.
sections.subtitle_en: From Rama to Imotski: announcements of gatherings and invitation to support the Queen of Peace center
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host announces the book promotion in Prozor and gatherings in Dalmatia
sections.content_en:
At the end of the show, Vladimir Grebenar brings announcements for the upcoming days. On that day, **Saturday, October 31**, a book promotion is held in **Prozor (Rama)**, in the hall of the Rama hydroelectric power plant. He asks listeners from northern Herzegovina to share the banner from the Ora et Labora Facebook page on their social networks and invite someone who could benefit from hearing the testimony and the word of the Lord.

Schedule of gatherings for next week, always starting at 7 p.m.:

- **Monday, November 2**: Biograd na Moru, Hotel Ilirija,
- **Tuesday, November 3**: Solin, Hotel President Solin,
- **Wednesday, November 4**: Imotski, Pučko otvoreno učilište Imotski.

The host advises visitors to arrive early to find a seat. The week after that he is traveling to Slavonija, and will announce the host cities later.

Grebenar invites everyone to become members of the **patriotic initiative Ora et Labora** via the website diol.hr or through the published mobile phone numbers. He also conveys a plea from Croats outside the homeland to invite compatriots from the diaspora to **the Rosary prayer in the main square in Zagreb**, and extends the invitation to the Rosary prayer to all other cities as well.

The broadcast ends with a blessing in the name of the Holy Mother, her Son, and Saint Joseph. Additionally, the host notes that the purchase of the first, second, and third *Isus Lider* book helps complete the **Queen of Peace International Educational Center in Međugorje**. The last words are an invitation to follow Ora et Labora every day, "for the greater glory of God."

iterations.theme_en: Interpretation of the Word of God: rejoicing in what Jesus rejoices in, humility, and personal testimony of the host
